lines: ［新娘］愿他用口与我亲嘴；
因你的爱情比酒更美。
Let him give me the kisses of his mouth: for his love is better than wine.
［新郎］我的佳偶在女子中，
好像百合花在荆棘内。
As the lily-flower among the thorns of the waste
so is my love among the daughters.
［新娘］求你将我放在你心上如印记，带在你臂上如戳记。因为爱情如死之坚强，嫉恨如阴间之残忍；所发的电光是火焰的电光，是耶和华的烈焰。
爱情，众水不能息灭，大水也不能淹没。若有人拿家中所有的财宝要换爱情，就全被藐视。
Put me as a sign on your heart, as a sign on your arm; love is strong as death, and wrath bitter as the underworld: its coals are coals of fire; violent are its flames.
Much water may not put out love, or the deep waters overcome it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would be judged a price not great enough.
好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，
谨守，贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毁谤。
Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,
To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
谨守，贞洁，料理家务，
待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，
免得神的道理被毁谤。
To be wise in mind
clean in heart
kind; working in their houses
living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样，
在教训上要正直、端庄，
In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching
serious in behaviour
分门结党的人，警戒过一两次，就要弃绝他。
因为知道这等人已经背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，还是去作。
A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;
Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.
不要毁谤，不要争竞，
总要和平，向众人大显温柔。
To say no evil of any man
not to be fighters
to give way to others
to be gentle in behaviour to all men.
他便救了我们，
并不是因我们自己所行的义，
乃是照他的怜悯，
借着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves
but in the measure of his mercy
he gave us salvation
through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit
那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。
And it will come about on that day that I will take in hand the destruction of all the nations who come against Jerusalem.
「万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。
不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」
This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your judging be upright and done in good faith, let every man have mercy and pity for his brother:
Do not be hard on the widow, or the child without a father, on the man from a strange country, or on the poor; let there be no evil thought in your heart against your brother.
